records.source: Shows what fish is on the line before it's caught.
records.translation: Ipinapakita kung anong isda ang nakakagat bago ito mahuli.
Anak ng Isdang Krimson

records.source: He hatched in the warm summer water, and followed in the footsteps of his father.
records.translation: Napisa ito sa mainit na tubig ng tag-init at sinundan ang yapak ng kaniyang ama.
Singsing na Sumisipsip ng Kaluluwa

records.source: Gain a little bit of energy every time you slay a monster.
records.translation: Nagbibigay ng kaunting enerhiya sa tuwing pumapatay ka ng halimaw.

records.preserveReason: Spaghetti is the conventional Filipino name for this pasta dish.

records.translation: Matagal nang paborito.
Mga Binhi ng Spangle
records.englishResidueReason: Spangle is retained as the fictional tropical flower variety name.

records.source: Plant in summer. Takes 8 days to produce a vibrant tropical flower. Assorted colors.
records.translation: Itanim sa tag-init. Tumatagal ng 8 araw upang magpatubo ng matingkad na tropikal na bulaklak. Sari-sari ang kulay.
Pain
Pinatataas ang tsansa mong makahuli ng {0}.
Pain para sa {0}

records.preserveReason: Speed-Gro is the exact in-game product brand retained across the Filipino corpus.

records.source: Stimulates leaf production. Guaranteed to increase growth rate by at least 10%. Mix into tilled soil.
records.translation: Pinasisigla ang pagtubo ng mga dahon. Garantisadong pinabibilis ang paglaki nang hindi bababa sa 10%. Ihalo sa binungkal na lupa.
Mabangong Bunga

records.source: It fills the air with a pungent aroma.
records.translation: Pinupuno nito ang hangin ng matapang na halimuyak.
Maanghang na Igat
Napakaanghang nito! Mag-ingat.
Paikutang Pangisda

records.source: The shape makes it spin around in the water. Slightly increases the bite-rate when fishing.
records.translation: Dahil sa hugis nito, umiikot ito sa tubig. Bahagyang pinatataas ang dalas ng pagkagat habang nangingisda.
Sulo ng Espiritu

records.source: It's unclear where the blue color comes from...
records.translation: Hindi malinaw kung saan nagmumula ang bughaw na kulay...
Isdang Sindak

records.source: The huge eyes can detect the faint silhouettes of prey.
records.translation: Nakikita ng malalaking mata nito ang malalabong anino ng biktima.
Sibuyas ng Tagsibol

records.source: These grow wild during the spring.
records.translation: Ligaw na tumutubo ang mga ito tuwing tagsibol.
Mga Binhi ng Tagsibol

records.source: An assortment of wild spring seeds.
records.translation: Sari-saring ligaw na binhi mula sa tagsibol.
Awtomatikong Pandilig

records.source: Waters the 4 adjacent tiles every morning.
records.translation: Dinidiligan ang 4 na katabing parisukat tuwing umaga.
Pusit

records.source: A deep sea creature that can grow to enormous size.
records.translation: Nilalang sa malalim na dagat na maaaring lumaki nang napakalaki.
Tinta ng Pusit

records.source: Squid use this ink to confuse would-be predators.
records.translation: Ginagamit ng mga pusit ang tintang ito upang lituhin ang mga mandaragit.
Ravioli na may Tinta ng Pusit
records.englishResidueReason: Ravioli is the conventional borrowed Filipino name for this pasta dish.

records.translation: Pansamantala kang pinoprotektahan mula sa mga negatibong epekto.
Rosas ng Stardew Valley
records.englishResidueReason: Stardew Valley is the canonical retained game and place name.

records.source: A rose that reminds you of the valley. It smells heavenly.
records.translation: Rosas na nagpapaalala sa iyo ng lambak. Napakabango nito.
Patak-Bituin

records.source: A mysterious fruit that empowers those who eat it. The flavor is like a dream... a powerful personal experience, yet difficult to describe to others.
records.translation: Misteryosong bungang nagbibigay-lakas sa sinumang kumain nito. Parang panaginip ang lasa... matindi at pansariling karanasan na mahirap ilarawan sa iba.
